mapper.select: SELECT PROJECTNAME PROJECTTWO,RELAORGNAME NAMETHREE,count(AA.PROJECTCOUNT) COUNTS,SUM(AA.yssl) YSSL,SUM(AA.sjsl) SJSL,SUM(AA.yssl)-SUM(AA.sjsl) WSSL,SUM(AA.bssl) BSSL from ( SELECT FAO.ORGNAME||'离任经济责任审计' AS PROJECTNAME, FAO.ORGID AS RELAORGID ,FAO.ORGNAME AS RELAORGNAME, (SELECT count(0) from TBL_YQNS_LEAVE_AUDIT_3L zs where ZS."ID"=TYLA."ID") AS PROJECTCOUNT, (SELECT count(0) from TBL_YQNS_LEAVE_AUDIT_3L ys where YS."ID"=TYLA."ID" and YS.IS_AUDIT=1) AS yssl, (SELECT count(0) from TBL_YQNS_LEAVE_AUDIT_3L bs where bs."ID"=TYLA."ID" and bs.IS_AUDIT=0) AS bssl, (SELECT count(0) from TBL_YQNS_LEAVE_AUDIT_3L sj where sj."ID"=TYLA."ID" and sj."ID" IN (SELECT GLID from TBL_YQNS_FUND_AUDIT_PROJECT_GL) ) AS sjsl FROM TBL_YQNS_LEAVE_AUDIT_3L TYLA LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION ORG ON TYLA.OLD_ORG_ID = ORG.ORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION FAO ON ORG.FATHERORGID = FAO.ORGID WHERE TYLA.ID IN (select NRID from TBL_YQNS_LEAVE_AUDIT_JD3L_GL where JDID IN ( SELECT JDID FROM TBL_YQNS_LEAVE_AUDIT_JD3L WHERE STATUS = 6 )) and TO_CHAR(TYLA.CREATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '${queryYear}%' ) aa GROUP BY AA.PROJECTNAME,RELAORGID,RELAORGNAME
